raw_identity_check: exact allowlisted path, producer-reported bytes/SHA recorded verbatim, actual size/mtime stable before and after scan; raw SHA NOT recomputed
imports: Python standard library only; no old controller/runner/physics/SDK imports
stop_events: first request yaw transition from positive or negative 4pi to zero within 0.03s of 10 or 22 control seconds; use actual estimate_time, not nominal boundary or row.time

segments.tail: last 1.0s of the actual stop phase
segments.whole_stop: zero request until next nonzero request or final post-step root timestamp

snapshot_rule: nearest existing control row, publish actual relative time; no interpolation
numeric_statistics: mean/RMS/min/max and mean/RMS residuals with finite checks; no fitted gain, controller replay or new score

time_semantics.control_epoch: estimate_time; request/shaped/estimated state and requested torque were computed before apply_torque_request
time_semantics.truth_before: V4grade current freejoint qpos/qvel at root_pose_velocity_time_s equal to control epoch; collision cache time is separate
time_semantics.truth_after: current root pose/velocity after 20 existing substeps, normally control epoch+0.01s
time_semantics.estimate_pitch: state14[2] first-order age-view to control epoch
time_semantics.estimate_vx_and_heading_rate: state14[7:9] held source-epoch filter/rate, not aged by _predict_view
time_semantics.source_pair: match source sensor_timestamp_s to prior/current truth_before within 1e-7s using at most 16-row history; otherwise null/unknown, never substitute current truth
time_semantics.sensor_aperture: recorded source end epoch labels 20-sample 2k boxcar gyro/rates plus D1/D3; not instantaneous or synchronized truth

wheel_diagnostics.order: row6 LH LC LW RH RC RW, wheel indices 2 and 5
wheel_diagnostics.observed: raw requested torque and last-substep actual_tau=d.ctrl; delayed boxcar wheel_rate2 is sensor feedback, not last-substep current-state speed
wheel_diagnostics.absolute_peak_hit: abs(abs(tau)-5.775909774436091)<=1e-8 is ONLY an absolute-cap coincidence count, not a signed-DC clip counter
wheel_diagnostics.gap: reported requested/last-substep gap may include processed target inversePD, D4 queue, current-state PD, D0 gain and signed DC; not uniquely saturation
unknown: target stages and per-stage clip masks

state_diagnostics: observe centering active, torque correction, capture mix/reference and accel_gain_used transitions; yaw I and enabled/low_ticks scalars are not logged and remain unknown
preserve_scores: copy four small-result phase metrics and transition_proposed_pass only; parent-supplied overall R26 0/8 and R27 both 2/8 unchanged; no heldout or other TRAIN trace opened
causal_limits: both combines lowspin accel correction and capture and may differ since startup; paired seeds are not isolated stop interventions; no unique causal attribution from two seeds
execution_limits: one bounded stdlib analysis process, no physics/model construction/compile/old QA/Git/agents/goal/blockedIO; no interaction with parent R52
